00072 void PlayBufUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00073 {   
00074     const int blockSize = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00075     
00076 //  if(buffer_.size() <= 0 || buffer_.size() <= 0)
00077 //  {
00078 //      for(int channel = 0; channel < getNumChannels(); channel++)
00079 //      {
00080 //          float* outputSamples = proxies[channel]->getSampleData();
00081 //          memset(outputSamples, 0, blockSize * sizeof(float));
00082 //      }
00083 //      
00084 //      return;
00085 //  }
00086     
00087     double channelBufferPos;
00088     
00089     for(int channel = 0; channel < getNumChannels(); channel++)
00090     {
00091         int numSamplesToProcess = blockSize;
00092         const int bufferSize = buffer_.size();
00093         channelBufferPos = bufferPos;
00094         float* outputSamples = proxies[channel]->getSampleData();
00095         float* rateSamples = inputs[Rate].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00096         float* trigSamples = inputs[Trig].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00097         float* offsetSamples = inputs[Offset].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00098         float* loopSamples = inputs[Loop].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00099                 
00100         while(numSamplesToProcess 
00101 //            && 
00102 //            (channelBufferPos < bufferSize) && 
00103 //            (channelBufferPos >= 0)
00104         ) {             
00105             float thisTrig = *trigSamples++;
00106             
00107             if(thisTrig > 0.f && lastTrig <= 0.f)
00108                 channelBufferPos = 0.0;
00109             
00110             double offset = *offsetSamples++;
00111             double position = offset + channelBufferPos;
00112             
00113             if(*loopSamples++ >= 0.5f) 
00114             {
00115                 if(position >= bufferSize)
00116                     position -= bufferSize;
00117                 else if(channelBufferPos < 0)
00118                     position += bufferSize;
00119                 
00120                 *outputSamples++ = buffer_.getSample(channel, position);
00121                 channelBufferPos += *rateSamples++;
00122             
00123                 if(channelBufferPos >= bufferSize)
00124                     channelBufferPos -= bufferSize;
00125                 else if(channelBufferPos < 0)
00126                     channelBufferPos += bufferSize;
00127             }
00128             else
00129             {
00130                 *outputSamples++ = buffer_.getSample(channel, position);
00131                 channelBufferPos += *rateSamples++;
00132             }
00133             
00134             --numSamplesToProcess;
00135             lastTrig = thisTrig;
00136         }
00137         
00138 //      if(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00139 //          memset(outputSamples, 0, numSamplesToProcess * sizeof(float));
00140     }
00141     
00142     bufferPos = channelBufferPos;
00143     
00144     if(bufferPos >= buffer_.size())
00145     {
00146         shouldDelete = shouldDelete ? true : shouldDeleteValue;
00147     }
00148 }

00152 PlayBuf::PlayBuf(Buffer const& buffer, 
00153                  UGen const& rate, 
00154                  UGen const& trigger, 
00155                  UGen const& startPos, 
00156                  UGen const& loop, 
00157                  const UGen::DoneAction doneAction) throw()
00158 {   
00159     // just mix the input ugens, they should be mono
00160     // mix() will just return the original UGen if it has only one channel anyway
00161     
00162     const int numChannels = buffer.getNumChannels();
00163     
00164     if(numChannels > 0 && buffer.size() > 0)
00165     {
00166         initInternal(numChannels);
00167         
00168         UGen startPosChecked = startPos.mix();
00169         generateFromProxyOwner(new PlayBufUGenInternal(buffer, 
00170                                                        rate.mix(), 
00171                                                        trigger.mix(), 
00172                                                        startPosChecked, 
00173                                                        loop.mix(), 
00174                                                        doneAction));
00175 
00176         for(int i = 0; i < numChannels; i++)
00177         {
00178             internalUGens[i]->initValue(buffer.getSample(i, startPosChecked.getValue(0)));
00179         }
00180     }
00181     
00182     // unnessecary the default constructor should have this in place
00183 //  else
00184 //  {
00185 //      initInternal(1);
00186 //      internalUGens[0] = getNullInternal();
00187 //  }
00188 }

00190 BufferValuesUGenInternal::BufferValuesUGenInternal(Buffer const& bufferToUse)
00191 :   ProxyOwnerUGenInternal(NumInputs, bufferToUse.size() - 1),
00192     buffer(bufferToUse)
00193 {
00194 }
00195 
00196 void BufferValuesUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, 
00197                                             const unsigned int blockID, 
00198                                             const int /*channel*/) throw()
00199 {
00200     for(int channel = 0; channel < getNumChannels(); channel++)
00201     {
00202         int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00203         float* outputSamples = proxies[channel]->getSampleData();
00204         float value = buffer[channel];
00205         
00206         while(numSamplesToProcess--) *outputSamples++ = value;
00207     }
00208 }
